EXPLANATORY NOTE
The sole purpose of this amendment to the Company’s Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q for the quarterly period ended March 23, 2013, originally filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission on May 14, 2013, is to furnish Exhibit 101 to the Form 10-Q, which contains the XBRL (eXtensible Business Reporting Language) Interactive Data File for the condensed consolidated financial statements and notes included in Part I, Item I of the Form 10-Q. As permitted by Rule 405(a)(2)(ii) of Regulation S-T, Exhibit 101 was required to be furnished by amendment within 30 days of the original filing date of the Form 10-Q.
No other changes have been made to the Form 10-Q, and the Form 10-Q has not been updated to reflect events occurring subsequent to the original filing date.
